description_en: Sends a voice verification code or a voice notification with variables to a specified phone number
description_zh: 调用接口给单个被叫号码发送语音验证码或文本转语音类型的语音通知
name: SingleCallByTts

parameters.help_en:
The number displayed to the called party.

You do not need to specify this parameter if you use the text-to-speech (TTS) notification template or voice verification code template for outbound calls in the common mode. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172104.html.
If you use the TTS notification template or voice verification code template for outbound calls in the dedicated mode, you must specify a number you purchased and only one number can be specified. You can log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home) and choose Voice Numbers > Real Number Management to view the number you purchased
parameters.help_zh:
发送语音通知或语音验证码的通话号码（被叫显号）。若此参数不填，则为公共模式通话；若传入真实号或服务实例ID，则为专属模式通话。参数`TtsCode`传入的模板ID的外呼模式必须与此处外呼模式匹配。

如果您使用公共模式，该参数不填，将由系统随机调度使用公共号码池内的号码通话。公共模式与专属模式区别请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172104.html。
如果您使用专属模式，请传入您的真实号码或服务实例ID。
您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)，在真实号管理页面查看已购买的真实号，在服务实例管理页面查看已创建并绑定真实号的服务实例
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number that receives voice notifications.

Number format in the Chinese mainland:

    *   Mobile phone number, for example, 159\\0000.
    *   Landline number, for example, 0571\\5678.

Number format outside the Chinese mainland: country code + phone number, for example, 85200\\00.



Each request supports only one called number. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150016.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270044.html.

Voice verification codes are sent to a called number at the following frequency: one time per minute, five times per hour, and 20 times per 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
接收语音通知或语音验证码的被叫号码。

号码格式：
手机号码。示例：159****0000。
固话号码。示例：0571****5678。
调用一次接口仅支持添加一个被叫号码。如果有多个被叫号码，可以多次调用。
同一个资质信息+号码用途，拨打每一个被叫号码的频次有流控限制：1次/分钟、5次/小时、20次/24小时。 流控规则计时从第一次正常外呼开始，超过这个频率就会触发流控。呼叫成功或失败都会消耗一次流控频率。
如使用专属模式调用此接口且您的业务需要更宽松的流控频率，您可至语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)--通用设置--呼叫设置--呼出流控-频次中，尝试申请调整流控次数，公共模式不支持
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approved TTS notification template or voice verification code template.

You can log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home), and choose Voice Messages > Voice Verification Codes or choose Voice Messages > Voice Notifications to view the template ID.

The account to which the TTS template belongs must be the same as the account that is used to call the SingleCallByTts operation
parameters.help_zh:
文本转语音模板或语音验证码模板的模板ID。
您可登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，在以下页面获取已通过审核的语音模板ID。
在语音消息>语音验证码获取模板ID。
在语音消息>语音通知页面获取模板ID。


<notice>

在控制台选择模板ID时请注意外呼号码字段是否与参数`CalledShowNumber`的外呼模式匹配。
语音模板归属账号和调用该接口的账号需保持一致。
</notice>
parameters.name: tts_code

parameters.help_en:
The variables in the template, in the JSON format.

The variables in the template must be less than 250 characters in length. The length of each single variable is not limited. These variables do not support URLs. The variables in the verification code template support only digits and letters
parameters.help_zh:
语音模板中的变量参数，JSON格式。
变量规范详情，请参见模板规范 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/user-guide/voice-template-specification?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6ebf68529bX2fG)
parameters.name: tts_param

parameters.help_en: The number of times a voice notification is played back in a call. Valid values: 1 to 3. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh: 语音文件或语音验证的播放次数。取值范围：1~3，默认取值3
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The playback volume of the voice notification. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 语音通话的音量。取值范围：0~100，默认取值100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The playback speed. Valid value: -500 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 语音通话的语速。取值范围为：-500~500
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en:
The custom ID that is reserved for the caller of the operation when the request is initiated. This ID is returned to the caller in a receipt message.

The value is of the STRING type and must be 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
发起请求时预留给调用方的自定义ID，最终会通过回执消息将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度限制为1~15个字符
parameters.name: out_id

CallId.description_en:
The unique receipt ID of the call.

You can call the [QueryCallDetailByCallId]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/393529.html） operation to query the details of the call based on the receipt ID
CallId.description_zh:
此次通话的唯一回执ID。

可以使用此CallId，调用[QueryCallDetailByCallId]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/393529.html）接口查询呼叫详情

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.
For more information about other response codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
